plain_description.what: Fixes a source-code guard test that had been failing on main. The test now allows exactly 7 known, recorded lines, while any new matching line still fails. Mutation tests confirm it behaves this way.
plain_description.why: A guard test that is always red hides new problems. This makes it green again without weakening it.
plain_description.information: A green, strict test restores protection against code that mishandles reserved (held-out) data. Result: done and merged, and the known failure on main is cleared. Caveats: some swap cases may not be caught, and a plain Gradle run can skip the test after tool changes, so a clean rebuild is required.
